s = open('scale.py').read()
start = s.index("# ---- 8192 vs 8193 prefix image validity ----")
new = '''# ---- 8192 vs 8193 distinct prefixes: semantic FIB bound ----
# Build groups of inline prefixes (TYPE4/5) so the NI vector stays within the
# wire bound while the represented FIB crosses 8192 distinct prefixes.
rng2 = random.Random(777)
groups = {}
i = 0
while len(groups) < 4095:
    hi = rng2.randrange(1 << 64)
    if hi not in groups:
        groups[hi] = [(128, (hi << 64) | (rng2.randrange(1 << 63) << 1)),
                      (128, (hi << 64) | (rng2.randrange(1 << 63) << 1) | 1)]
routes2 = {}
for hi, lst in groups.items():
    for (ln, a) in lst:
        routes2[(ln, mask(a, ln))] = rng2.randrange(0, 4194303)
# one extra group of three with distinct 6-bit chunks
hi = max(groups) + 1
extra = [(128, (hi << 64) | (0 << 26)), (128, (hi << 64) | (1 << 26)),
         (128, (hi << 64) | (2 << 26))]
for (ln, a) in extra:
    routes2[(ln, mask(a, ln))] = rng2.randrange(0, 4194303)
assert len(routes2) == 8193, len(routes2)
img_bad = py_build(routes2, rng2)
routes_ok = dict(routes2)
del routes_ok[extra[-1]]
assert len(routes_ok) == 8192
img_ok = py_build(routes_ok, rng2)
print('ni vector ok:', len(img_ok['nexthops']), 'bad:', len(img_bad['nexthops']))
ops = [['load', img_ok], ['load', img_bad],
       ['image_query', [h(extra[0][1])]],
       ['image_query', [h(extra[-1][1])]]]
out = run_req({'cases': [{'ops': ops}]}, 'scale-limit')
r = out['results'][0]
print('loads:', r['loads'])
assert r['loads'] == [True, False], '8192/8193 limit'
assert r['answers'] == [lpm(routes_ok, extra[0][1]), None], f'limit answers {r["answers"]}'
print('SCALE OK')
'''
s = s[:start] + new
